requirements.proofOfAddressDescription: A utility bill, lease agreement, or official mail showing your current address.

entry.signInLink: Sign in with an existing account

help.heading: Help

faq.q1: Where do I find my case code?
faq.a1: It's printed on the notice you received by mail or text, formatted like NNW-482931. If you can't find it, sign in with your account instead.
faq.q2: What counts as proof of address?
faq.a2: A utility bill, lease agreement, or official mail dated within the last 60 days showing your name and current address.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss the deadline?
faq.a3: Your case may be delayed or denied for missing information. Submitting even a few days late is better than not submitting at all — upload as soon as you can.

help.callbackSubtext: Skip the hold queue. Leave your number and a caseworker will call you back.
help.callbackConfirmed: Got it — someone will call you back soon.
